🆕 NEW RELEASE: Slowly Slowly share new single 'Too Good To Be True'

The Australian band released the single on 20 November 2026. It is the third song from their sixth album, Everybody Tells The Truth, due on 5 February 2027 via Nettwerk Music Group. Frontman Ben Stewart describes it as a breakup song about deception.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Massendefekt wrap up their 25th anniversary tour

German alternative rock band Massendefekt are closing out their 25 Live anniversary tour. The remaining dates are Bremen's Tower Musikclub on 27 November, Münster's Sputnikhalle on 28 November and Düsseldorf's Stahlwerk on 12 December 2026.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Broilers announce Banda Live 2027 tour

Broilers have announced the Banda Live 2027 tour, eleven open-air and arena shows between 29 July and 25 September 2027 in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. German stops include Hamburg, Berlin's Waldbühne and Munich's Olympiahalle.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: The Warning announce German headline shows for March 2027

Mexican trio The Warning play their first big German headline shows in March 2027 on the Everything's Falling World Tour. Dates are Munich's Zenith on 18 March, Düsseldorf's Mitsubishi Electric Halle on 19 March and Berlin's Uber Eats Music Hall on 21 March.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Taking Back Sunday join When We Were Young 2027

Taking Back Sunday and The Used are on the lineup for When We Were Young 2027, set for 16 October 2027 in Las Vegas. Other confirmed names include blink-182, Pierce The Veil, All Time Low, Simple Plan and New Found Glory.
